gold_sql:
WITH model_issue_counts AS (
    SELECT
        bm.model_id,
        bm.model_name,
        bm.is_electric,
        COUNT(*) AS maintenance_jobs
    FROM bike_models AS bm
    JOIN bikes AS b
        ON b.model_id = bm.model_id
    JOIN maintenance AS m
        ON m.bike_id = b.bike_id
    GROUP BY
        bm.model_id,
        bm.model_name,
        bm.is_electric
),
restricted_models AS (
    SELECT
        model_id,
        model_name,
        is_electric,
        maintenance_jobs
    FROM model_issue_counts
    WHERE maintenance_jobs > (
        SELECT AVG(maintenance_jobs)
        FROM model_issue_counts
    )
),
ranked_models AS (
    SELECT
        model_id,
        model_name,
        is_electric,
        maintenance_jobs,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY is_electric
            ORDER BY maintenance_jobs DESC
        ) AS maintenance_rank
    FROM restricted_models
),
survivors AS (
    SELECT
        model_id,
        model_name,
        is_electric,
        maintenance_jobs
    FROM ranked_models
    WHERE maintenance_rank = 1
)
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN is_electric = 1 THEN 'electric'
        ELSE 'non_electric'
    END AS power_type,
    SUM(maintenance_jobs) AS top_rank_maintenance_jobs,
    ROUND(
        1.0 * SUM(maintenance_jobs)
        / SUM(SUM(maintenance_jobs)) OVER (),
        4
    ) AS share_of_top_rank_maintenance_jobs
FROM survivors
GROUP BY is_electric
ORDER BY share_of_top_rank_maintenance_jobs DESC

WITH borough_station_counts AS (
  SELECT
    b.borough_id,
    b.borough_name,
    COUNT(s.station_id) AS station_count
  FROM boroughs AS b
  JOIN stations AS s
    ON s.borough_id = b.borough_id
  WHERE s.is_active = 1
  GROUP BY b.borough_id, b.borough_name
),
target_boroughs AS (
  SELECT
    borough_id
  FROM borough_station_counts
  WHERE station_count >= 10
),
daily_precip AS (
  SELECT
    wd.day,
    SUM(wd.precip_mm) AS total_precip_mm
  FROM weather_daily AS wd
  JOIN target_boroughs AS tb
    ON wd.borough_id = tb.borough_id
  GROUP BY wd.day
),
running_precip AS (
  SELECT
    day,
    SUM(total_precip_mm) OVER (
      ORDER BY day
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS cumulative_precip_mm
  FROM daily_precip
)
SELECT
  MAX(cumulative_precip_mm) AS final_cumulative_precip_mm
FROM running_precip

WITH member_trip_stats AS (
    SELECT
        m.member_id,
        COUNT(t.trip_id) AS trip_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(t.started_at)) AS active_days,
        AVG(t.distance_km) AS avg_distance_km,
        MAX(t.fare_cents) AS max_fare_cents,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ss.borough_id = es.borough_id AND es.borough_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0
            / NULLIF(COUNT(t.trip_id), 0) AS same_borough_trip_ratio,
        CASE
            WHEN COUNT(t.trip_id) = 0 THEN 'no_trips'
            WHEN AVG(t.distance_km) >= 8 THEN 'long_distance'
            WHEN AVG(t.distance_km) >= 4 THEN 'medium_distance'
            ELSE 'short_distance'
        END AS distance_profile_label
    FROM members m
    JOIN trips t
        ON t.member_id = m.member_id
    LEFT JOIN stations ss
        ON t.start_station_id = ss.station_id
    LEFT JOIN stations es
        ON t.end_station_id = es.station_id
    GROUP BY m.member_id
)
SELECT
    member_id,
    trip_count * 1.0 / active_days AS trips_per_active_day,
    trip_count AS trip_count,
    active_days AS active_days,
    avg_distance_km AS avg_distance_km,
    max_fare_cents AS max_fare_cents,
    same_borough_trip_ratio AS same_borough_trip_ratio,
    distance_profile_label AS distance_profile_label
FROM member_trip_stats
ORDER BY trips_per_active_day DESC, trip_count DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH plan_trip_stats AS (
    SELECT
        p.plan_id,
        p.plan_name,
        COUNT(t.trip_id) AS total_trips_including_casual,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN t.member_id IS NOT NULL THEN t.trip_id END) AS member_trips_only,
        COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS member_count
    FROM plans AS p
    LEFT JOIN members AS m
        ON m.plan_id = p.plan_id
    LEFT JOIN trips AS t
        ON t.member_id = m.member_id
    GROUP BY
        p.plan_id,
        p.plan_name
),
plan_rates AS (
    SELECT
        plan_id,
        plan_name,
        total_trips_including_casual,
        member_trips_only,
        member_count,
        ROUND(
            1.0 * total_trips_including_casual / NULLIF(member_count, 0),
            2
        ) AS trips_per_member_incorrect_denominator_demo,
        ROUND(
            1.0 * member_trips_only / NULLIF(member_count, 0),
            2
        ) AS member_trips_per_member,
        CASE
            WHEN 1.0 * member_trips_only / NULLIF(member_count, 0) >= 30 THEN 'very_high_engagement'
            WHEN 1.0 * member_trips_only / NULLIF(member_count, 0) >= 20 THEN 'high_engagement'
            WHEN 1.0 * member_trips_only / NULLIF(member_count, 0) >= 10 THEN 'medium_engagement'
            WHEN 1.0 * member_trips_only / NULLIF(member_count, 0) > 0 THEN 'low_engagement'
            ELSE 'no_engagement'
        END AS engagement_band
    FROM plan_trip_stats
)
SELECT
    plan_id,
    plan_name,
    member_count,
    total_trips_including_casual,
    member_trips_only,
    trips_per_member_incorrect_denominator_demo,
    member_trips_per_member,
    engagement_band
FROM plan_rates
WHERE member_count > 0
ORDER BY member_trips_per_member DESC, plan_id

        b.model_id,

WITH tech_stats AS (
    SELECT
        t.technician_id,
        t.technician_name,
        b.borough_name AS depot_borough_name,
        COUNT(m.job_id) AS total_jobs,
        COUNT(DISTINCT m.bike_id) AS distinct_bikes_serviced,
        AVG(m.cost_cents) AS avg_job_cost_cents,
        MAX(m.cost_cents) AS max_job_cost_cents,
        AVG(
            CASE
                WHEN m.completed_at IS NOT NULL
                THEN julianday(m.completed_at) - julianday(m.reported_at)
            END
        ) AS avg_resolution_days,
        SUM(CASE WHEN m.completed_at IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(m.job_id) AS open_job_ratio,
        COUNT(DISTINCT m.station_id) AS distinct_stations_visited,
        CASE
            WHEN COUNT(m.job_id) >= 80 THEN 'high_volume'
            WHEN COUNT(m.job_id) >= 40 THEN 'medium_volume'
            ELSE 'low_volume'
        END AS workload_label
    FROM technicians t
    LEFT JOIN maintenance m
        ON t.technician_id = m.technician_id
    LEFT JOIN boroughs b
        ON t.depot_borough_id = b.borough_id
    GROUP BY
        t.technician_id,
        t.technician_name,
        b.borough_name
    HAVING COUNT(m.job_id) > 0
)
SELECT
    technician_id,
    technician_name,
    depot_borough_name,
    workload_label,
    total_jobs,
    distinct_bikes_serviced,
    avg_job_cost_cents,
    max_job_cost_cents,
    ROUND(avg_resolution_days, 2) AS avg_resolution_days,
    ROUND(open_job_ratio, 3) AS open_job_ratio,
    distinct_stations_visited
FROM tech_stats
ORDER BY total_jobs DESC, technician_id
